description: THE CORE-EMOTION SET (block 204000) as APPRAISAL -> ACTION-TENDENCY rules over the EXISTING signal economy -- NOT a new module. Each emotion is a RULE reading the same integer atoms already in the tree: the 196000 staleness_decay freshness = Ashr(c0, IDiv(now-last_refresh, half_life)) (scale2 half-life) + the 199000 present readout (freshness>=t_present) -> a threat precision that DECAYS is FEAR, one that WON'T is ANXIETY (the same PTSD knob, appraised as emotion); the 202000 learning_progress = residual_prev - residual -> CURIOSITY(>0)/BOREDOM(->0) (the noisy-TV cut); the 202000 diminishing-returns value = V_max - Ashr(V_max, step) -> JOY's value_progress, and the scale2 decay Ashr(v0,k) -> SADNESS's un-re-groundable loss. Appraisal theory (Scherer/Lazarus/Frijda action tendencies); the circumplex (valence=sign of progress/value, arousal=magnitude of surprise/precision) read off in-graph. THE REFERENCE-FRAME-PER-EMOTION PRINCIPLE: each emotion's value function reads value at a LEVEL OF SELECTION -- the individual emotions read the individual ledger (happiness = benefit-cost); FULFILMENT reads the SUPERGRAPH (w_supergraph gates the contribution term), fires when the agent's action raised the COLLECTIVE's success, and is DISTINCT from joy. G4 value-side disorder glass-box (ties 199000): PSYCHOPATHY = the w_supergraph knob at ~0 (reads others -- contribution still computed -- but does not VALUE them -> fulfilment collapses, the somatic brake on supergraph-harmful acts is removed); pure-knob reversal restores it. mood_bias suppresses (depression) / inflates (mania) value across BOTH frames. The behavioural factors are SHADOWS of the state-knobs. Integer-native (Ashr/IDiv/Minus/Plus/Abs/IfThenElse/Eq/Gt/Lt/Gte/And/Or/Not only); NO Rust, NO new Term. OFF by default: every rule guards on a HeldEmotionParams.enabled node the measure adapter creates only on opt-in; absent it every existing path is byte-identical. Understanding not judgment; the FUNCTIONAL regulator, NOT a claim to felt qualia.

microtheory.name: core_emotions
microtheory.description: An emotion is an appraisal of the signal economy that produces an action tendency; its value function reads a level of selection (individual vs supergraph). Same integer decay/progress/value atoms as perception/curiosity; fulfilment is the supergraph frame, psychopathy the supergraph-value knob at zero.
